g.text: A: Original data (V2 API confirmed dates only)
B: Including recovered dates (V3 API + bulk Excel)
Scenario A uses only dates available in the original V2 API pull.
Scenario B adds dates recovered from the WB V3 API and bulk Excel (confirmed by both sources).
IBRD Commitment Timeline: Original vs Recovered Dates
Source: World Bank Projects API (search.worldbank.org). P122265 ($200M, 2014) is the only positive-financing project added in the 2013–2019 window. Its status is Dropped (APL).
